faq.a: Where the attached stock sits: East Central held 120 condos & townhomes listings and West Central 78 in September 2026 — about seven in ten of the city's attached listings — and the live page's visible cards are labelled East Central and West Central; those are inventory counts for condos and townhomes combined, not a count of condos under the cap (SnapStats, September 2026)
faq.q: Where do Maple Ridge condos under $800K actually sit?

faq.a: The cap sits above the market's middle: the Maple Ridge condos & townhomes median sale price was $525,000 in September 2026 — $275,000 below the cap — though that median mixes townhomes with condos and swung from $640,000 in August 2026 on small sold counts, so treat it as context for where the cap sits, not as the price of a typical condo (SnapStats, September 2026)
faq.q: Does the $800K cap cover the typical Maple Ridge condo?

faq.a: The strata package (Form B, depreciation report, minutes, insurance certificate) under the provincial strata framework — strata disputes can go to the Civil Resolution Tribunal — plus, for a building at the Port Haney river edge, the floodplain check: flood construction level 6.7 m geodetic and a covenant on title for floodplain construction.
faq.q: What should I check before removing subjects on a Maple Ridge condo?

faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.
faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in Maple Ridge?

faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.
faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in Maple Ridge?
